description: Resilience in the Face of Climate Change: Envisioning Success - Measuring Progress is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Estuarine Research Reserve System | Science Collaborative; Susanne Moser Research and Consulting; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. This website offers strategies and tools for measuring adaptation success. It can help people answer several critical questions that many planners, resource managers, resilience officers, and adaptation practitioners ask: This website offers a user-friendly guide through these questions. You will find tools to help you arrive at answers that fit your local context. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
